**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Fence forbidden reads before retrying**

When membership is revoked while a cached transcript is open, the first scoped GET returns 403, but the query still has `retry: 1` and this handler does not call `onDenied` until React Query exposes the terminal error after the retry. During that retry delay `deniedAt` remains unset, so both the cached messages and composer stay rendered despite the refusal; after the final failure, the passive effect also permits an additional paint before fencing. Make `forbidden` non-retryable and include the current forbidden result in the synchronous render gate so the first 403 hides the view immediately.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
